# Delphi

> A multi-agent working environment for research, strategy and product work, with software built spec-first. One Rust executable plus a full-screen console: thirteen specialist roles work together and argue in Councils, keep memory and context between sessions, run in the console and inside other agent tools over MCP (Claude Code, Copilot CLI, Codex), grow a local knowledge base whose claims carry sources and a status, and ask the operator before anything leaves the sandbox. Pre-1.0; macOS and Linux.

Start with the README, then the guides. The specs are the design and say, in a `status` line, whether the operator has approved each.

## Use it

- [README](README.md): what it is, why it exists, how agents work together, memory and context, environments, the knowledge base, install, quick start, limitations
- [Thesis](docs/thesis.md): why Delphi exists (research and strategy with shared, trusted knowledge), the claim, and how to judge a change
- [Getting started](docs/getting-started.md): install, first session, first build
- [Model access](docs/guides/model-access.md): endpoints, subscriptions, failover, local fallback
- [Builds and Councils](docs/guides/builds-and-councils.md): the build ladder, gates, optimistic builds, Councils
- [Headless runs and CI](docs/guides/headless-and-ci.md): `delphi run`, card policies, exit codes
- [Away mode](docs/guides/away-mode.md): the email/Telegram relay, timers, hooks
- [Using Delphi from other tools](docs/guides/using-delphi-from-other-tools.md): `delphi mcp` for Claude Code, Copilot, Codex, agy
- [Ecosystem files](ecosystem/README.md): the generated Claude Code plugin and marketplace (`.claude-plugin/marketplace.json`); `delphi docs ecosystem --check`
- [Org bundles](docs/guides/org-bundles.md): share knowledge, skills and goals; Claude Code plugin interchange
- [Building a bundle with an operator](docs/guides/building-a-bundle.md): START HERE to build a bundle interactively: what to read, the interview, where each answer goes, where to stop
- [Xenia operator guide](docs/guides/xenia-operator.md): join, run and recover the org's signed memory store
- [Merging core changes](docs/guides/merging-core-changes.md): the merge queue, `delphi merge`, approval records, gate-changing paths, cleanup (design; slices S3-S6 not all built)
- [Troubleshooting](docs/troubleshooting.md)

## Machine-readable formats (JSON Schema)

- [config.schema.json](schemas/config.schema.json): workspace `config.toml`
- [bundle.schema.json](schemas/bundle.schema.json): org bundle `bundle.toml`
- [source-meta.schema.json](schemas/source-meta.schema.json): `meta.json` of a bundle source
- [event-envelope.schema.json](schemas/event-envelope.schema.json): mission event log lines and `delphi run --jsonl`
- [handoff-envelope.schema.json](schemas/handoff-envelope.schema.json): handoffs between agents
- [research-result.schema.json](schemas/research-result.schema.json): what a host agent gets back from research
- [prompt-log.schema.json](schemas/prompt-log.schema.json): one entry of the artifact prompt log (spec 070)
- [seat-receipt.schema.json](schemas/seat-receipt.schema.json): payload of a `seat.receipt` event (spec 091)
- [authorization-request.schema.json](schemas/authorization-request.schema.json): a staged request for the operator to authorize a test (spec 092)
- [authorization-record.schema.json](schemas/authorization-record.schema.json): `operator/authorizations.json`, the operator's test authorizations (spec 092)
- [xenia-record.schema.json](schemas/xenia-record.schema.json) and [xenia-sidecar.schema.json](schemas/xenia-sidecar.schema.json): signed org memory records
- [agent-manifest.schema.json](schemas/agent-manifest.schema.json) and [skill-manifest.schema.json](schemas/skill-manifest.schema.json): `AGENT.md` and `SKILL.md` frontmatter

## Design

- [Charter](GOVERNANCE.md) and [review rubric](REVIEW.md)
- [compiled/specs/](compiled/specs/index.md): a derived, byte-exact view of every spec (one JSON file each, a few readable pages by group). Read it with `delphi specs show <spec>`; the source spec decides ([CONTRIBUTING](CONTRIBUTING.md), "Compiled specs")
- [specs/](specs/): governance and manifests (001), adapter and routing (002), Council (003), memory and search (004), console (005*), installer (006), model access (009), connectors (010), Xenia trust, records and librarian (011-013, 022), documents and charts (095), headless run (016), org bundles (023-027), agent registry (041, approved, not built), layered learning (031), signed releases (036), training experiments (037), Delphi for host agents over MCP (062, approved, not built)
